title: Lost-Supply Allowance (Home Delivery Pharmacy Credits Rate Card)
content:
## Credits rate card: allowance for the supply that failed

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy missed-delivery credit, a lost-supply allowance is added by the days supply of the replaced shipment: for a supply of 61 days or more it is figured per day, 0.05 for each day of the replaced supply; for a supply of 31 through 60 days it is a flat 2.50; and for a supply of 30 days or fewer there is none.

The days supply read is the days supply on the original shipment record of the replaced order. The allowance is added to the credit.

### Method by days supply

| Days supply of the replaced shipment | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 61 or more | 0.05 times the days supply |
| 31 through 60 | a flat 2.50, whatever the days supply |
| 30 or fewer | none |

### Worked cases (hypothetical shipments)

| Days supply | Band | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 100 | 61 or more | 0.05 times 100, 5.00 |
| 90 | 61 or more | 0.05 times 90, 4.50 |
| 61 | 61 or more | 0.05 times 61, 3.05 |
| 60 | 31 through 60 | 2.50 |
| 31 | 31 through 60 | 2.50 |
| 30 | 30 or fewer | none |
